summary: The agent correctly avoids global data leakage by splitting the data before applying feature selection and PCA, and properly sets up an ensembling framework. However, it makes critical errors by failing to apply feature scaling before using scale-sensitive algorithms and by performing feature extraction on the entire training set prior to cross-validation, which introduces fold-level data leakage.
